Usage of Storm Sewers by Others
The Division-owned storm sewer systems are designed for the use of the State highways they serve. Allowances are made during design to accommodate the surface drainage of those areas outside the right of way which slopes naturally towards the roadway.
DRAINAGE VIOLATIONS
Action not complying with the drainage law in Illinios, such as obstruction of natural water courses, illegal sewer connections, or the deprivation of the Division drainage rights by any means, shall be thoroughly investigated by the Division and referred to the office of the Attorney General for legal action.
PROVISIONS FOR FUTURE DRAINAGE
In planning and designing highway facilities, the Division is responsible for providing drainage to the approximate standard which existed prior to the construction of the highway. The Division is not obligated nor is it permitted to expend public funds for private benefits.
1. Natural Drainage
The highway facility shall be designed to provide for the present natural flow in addition to increased flow created by improvements made or to be made to the drainage system within the provisions of the natural rules of drainage by the landowner of the upper drainage area. If the improvements have not been completed by the time the Division is preparing plans, the landowner shall provide documented evidence that the improvements to the drainage system will be completed within a limited period of time before consideration will be given for increasing the size of opening for such work.
